outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success rate
cohort: 708 pregnant women who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
finding: Maternal height, maternal BMI at delivery, fundal height, cervix Bishop score, maternal age at delivery, gestational age, and history of vaginal delivery were independently associated with successful VBAC.
mod_finding: This study developed a nomogram to predict successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
